environment_v1.reason: SDXL draft did not include a usable tea table or cup, dog is white rather than tan and white, and composition is an exterior facade rather than reachable bench seating. Kept as a failed preproduction trial; not sent to Wan.

dog_asset_v1.reason: Pose is readable but coat has large dark areas and render is more illustrated than the Han Li 3D reference; do not use as final identity anchor.

character_v1.reason: Front and three-quarter views preserve recognizable costume and identity; rightmost angle is not a strict profile.

character_v2.reason: Rightmost profile is usable; middle view also changed. Selected sheet combines v1 front/three-quarter and v2 profile without repainting.

dog_reference_v1.reason: One sleepy tan-and-white dog, clear anatomy and coherent 3D rendering; used as the second scene reference.

tea_frame_v1.reason: Three hands and two cups. Never used as Wan input.

tea_frame_v2.reason: Two arms and hands, one held cup, recognizable costume, reachable dog. Dog is on the table rather than planned bench; accept that staging and preserve it across shots.

dog_frame_v1.reason: Hand naturally contacts dog head; matching scene and costume; cup missing.

dog_frame_v2.reason: Adding cup replaced teapot. Extract cup for local compositing instead of changing the accepted scene.

dog_frame_selected.reason: Preserves v1 dog/hand/scene and teapot, adds cutout cup from v2. Deterministic local compositing documented in composition.json.

tea_v1.reason: Sampled every 0.5 seconds: cup rises to lips, is held for a sip, and lowers near the end; character and dog remain coherent. Fine face detail softens during motion.

dog_v1.reason: Sampled every 0.5 seconds: hand moves from forehead toward ear/side of head; dog stays sleepy. A gentle stroke is visible, but not two distinct complete back-and-forth strokes.

final_v2.method: Raw clips sampled at 2 fps, final sampled at 1 fps; complete FFmpeg decode and metadata checks.
final_v2.findings: Readable Chinese subtitles, both requested actions visible, coherent setting. Cut at 5 seconds omits cup placement; no phoneme lip sync. Subject likeness remains a generated interpretation.
